newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS confirms Molson Cos Ltd ratings.
newsitem.headline: CBRS confirms Molson Cos Ltd ratings.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Monday that it reaffirmed its ratings for brewing and sports giant Molson Cos Ltd.
CBRS said in a statement that it reaffirmed Molson's commercial paper at A-1+ and its senior unsecured debt at A.

CBRS made the annoucement after an arbitration panel ruled late Friday that Molson Breweries reliquished its right to brew and sell Coors products in April, 1993 when Miller Brewing Co. acquired a stake in the Canadian beermaker.

Molson is owned 40 percent each by Molson Cos and Foster's Brewing Group Ltd and 20 percent by Philip Morris Co's Miller Brewing unit. The panel ordered Molson to pay Coors all the profit it earned from selling Coors beer since 1993, an amount which has yet to be determined. "Until such time as the full extent of the award is determined, CBRS will maintain the current ratings," CBRS said.
